content.content: deccy records a file edit by placing it in the owning node's change: an edit serving a node's own decision joins that node's change; an edit serving a different purpose joins that purpose's node, or a new node when none exists. No edit lands outside an owning change.
content.rationale: Attribution is what keeps history readable as decisions; a misfiled edit corrupts the one-change-one-node mapping everything else relies on.
